name: Kurkure Hyderabadi Hungama
ingredients_raw: Rice Meal (42.5%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil), Corn Meal (20.0%), Gram Meal (3.3%), Salt, Sugar, Spices & Condiments (Chilli Powder, Pepper Powder, Garlic Powder, Curry Leaf Powder, Onion Powder, Turmeric Powder, Fenugreek Powder, Cumin, Mace Powder, Coriander Powder, Cinnamon Powder, Clove, Ginger Powder), Tomato Powder (0.5%), Vegetable Powder, Malic Acid (296), Citric Acid (330). Contains permitted natural colour (150d) & added flavours (natural, nature identical & artificial (tomato) flavouring substances)
